chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from more than one person, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Regarding a man who trades with another man over an item, he عليه السلام said: “There is no harm, if the origin of the item is halal (permissible).”

key_terms.الشَّيْءِ: the item or thing being transacted
key_terms.حَلَالًا: lawful and permissible in the Shar'i sense
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection
key_terms.يُبَايِعُ: engages in a sale or transaction

ai.seo_question: Is a transaction permissible if the original item being traded is halal?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a transaction between two men over an item. The Imam عليه السلام states that such dealing is unobjectionable when the underlying item itself is halal (permissible) in origin.
